caption: A glossy blue, egg-shaped vessel with a clear glass pedestal foot stands centered on a light-gray turntable against black. A crown of blue and gold paint flares above it, with a thick yellow lobe on one side, a pointed blue disk on the other, and a fan of fine spray filaments trailing left. As the turntable spins, the yellow lobe and rim drips shift position around the vertical axis. The delicate spray filaments shorten and fade over the first part. Meanwhile the striped column of paint between crown and bulb stretches upward and narrows, lifting the flared top higher above the body. The blue rim droops and its drip tips lengthen and sag.
relations: Turntable rotation shifts the yellow lobe and rim drips around the vertical axis.
The fan of spray filaments shortens and fades during the initial rotation.
The striped paint column stretches upward and narrows, lifting the flared top higher.
The blue rim droops, causing its drip tips to lengthen and sag.
